Work independently, enjoy plenty of freedom, and hit the road every day? Become a Delivery Driver Jumbo in Amsterdam through Consolid and start working at Jumbo right away. Deliver groceries throughout the region in a varied and independent role. Wat bieden wij? €17.75 gross per hour from the age of 21, including holiday pay, statutory vacation days, and ADV allowance; 50% extra pay for working between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM; 100% extra pay on public holidays; 20 vacation days per year based on a full-time contract of 40 hours per week; Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometre from 10.1 km up to a maximum of 35 km one-way; Pension plan; Meal allowance for late shifts; Part-time work available; A high level of independence during your working day; Driving a modern Jumbo delivery van; Career development opportunities within Jumbo and Consolid; Prospect of a permanent contract with Jumbo. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Jumbo | Start now | Amsterdam Start your working day at the Jumbo Hub in Amsterdam. Together with your colleagues, you check the daily schedule, prepare your route, and head out in a modern Jumbo delivery van. You will deliver groceries to customers at home and at business locations throughout Amsterdam. As a Delivery Driver, you are one of the faces of Jumbo. You deliver groceries safely, on time, and with a friendly attitude. Whether you are driving through busy streets, finding parking in the city centre, or carrying grocery crates upstairs, you remain professional and customer-focused. Thanks to your excellent service, every customer receives their order with a smile. No two working days are the same. You will drive different routes, visit a variety of locations, and meet many different customers throughout the day. You start at the Jumbo Hub in Amsterdam, check your route, and head out in a modern

delivery van. During your shift, you deliver groceries throughout Amsterdam and the surrounding area. Do I need experience? Previous delivery experience is not required. However, you must have at least 3 months of independent driving experience and hold a valid Category B driving licence (manual transmission). Can I work part-time? Yes, this is a part-time position. You must be available on at least 2 days per week, with availability on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday or Saturday. Working on Saturdays is highly preferred. Ready to start a new job?

Looking for an active warehouse job?

Start your next job at GXO Logistics in Tilburg!

Work in a modern warehouse with an international team. You will pick, pack, and ship customer orders correctly and on time.

No warehouse experience? That's okay! If you are motivated, willing to learn, and like to stay active, we will train you and help you grow.

Please note: This is an active, physical job. You'll be walking, standing and moving throughout your shift.

What will you do?

As a Warehouse Employee, you can work in different departments.

Order Picking

- Pick products using a hand scanner.
- Collect the correct items for customer orders.
- Make sure orders are complete.

Packing

- Scan products.
- Check orders before shipment.
- Print shipping labels.

Returns

- Inspect returned products.
- Decide whether products can be returned to stock.
- Process returns in the warehouse system.

Together with your colleagues, you'll ensure every product is handled carefully from the moment it arrives until it leaves the warehouse.

What do we ask?

- You speak and understand basic English (minimum B1).
- You are available full-time or part-time.
- You enjoy active work and are physically fit.
- You can stand and walk throughout your shift.
- You have your own accommodation and transportation.
- You can apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).

Working hours in aTwo-shift system

Morning: 06:00 - 14:45

Afternoon: 15:15 - 00:00

Approved ROV training, and experience driving an ROV in an operational setting

A technical or electrical education, and practical experience from maintenance and fault-finding on mechanical, hydraulic and electrical systems

Experience of leading a small team, or the clear ambition and ability to take that step

The discipline to work by written procedures and checklists, and to get reports out on time

Working proficiency in English, and fitness for physical work at quaysides, on pontoons and on board vessels

You are the senior person on the station and the point of contact for everyone who deals with it  the crew, the vessel, the port and our own management. The work is governed by procedures, checklists and manufacturers' manuals, and we operate alongside customers, ports and crews who expect us to do things the same way every time. As supervisor you set the standard for that, and you are responsible for a safe workplace and a clean operation at all times.

Experience in a production environment is an advantage but not required.
You are physically fit and able to perform demanding manual work.
You work accurately and pay attention to detail.
You enjoy working as part of a team.
You are willing to work in shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
You speak either Dutch or English.

Ready to pack some joy behind the scenes at Søstrene Grene? We’re looking for a Pick & Pack Specialist to join our team!
You’ll be picking and packing orders for both our stores and online customers. It’s physically light work where you’ll get to work with cool automated robots alongside manual systems, so having a good eye for counting numbers is key. Working in a comfortable 2-shift rotation, you can earn up to €19.80 per hour in a friendly, tech-smart warehouse! Read on and I will tell you everything about this amazing vacancy..

What we offer
- Top pay up to €19.80 per hour!
- Higher starting wage for your experience
- Tasty lunch options on early shifts
- Free breakfast every Tuesday & Thursday
- Get paid while taking your short breaks
- No heavy uniform—just wear your own clothes!

Who you are
As our picking and packing specialist, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You can work in a 2 shift system ( 7.00-15.00 / 15.00 - 23.00 )
- You have your own transport to work in Sevenum/Venlo
- You are full time available
- You understand and speak English

What will you do
As our new Pick & Pack Specialist, you’ll be at the heart of our fulfillment process! You’ll get to work with an amazing blend of smart warehouse robots and manual systems to process orders for both our aesthetic retail stores and online customers. Armed with a great eye for numbers, you’ll count, double-check, and pack charming Scandinavian products into neat parcels. Since the work is physically light, you’ll stay fresh and energized while keeping the goods flowing smoothly and accurately!

Where will you work
Step into a modern, high-tech warehouse with a warm Scandinavian feel! At Søstrene Grene, you’ll work alongside friendly colleagues—and futuristic robots—in a clean, well-organized environment. We work in a comfortable 2-shift rotation, keeping the energy high and the teamwork strong.

We love making our workplace feel like home. That means fueling your week with a
